home.title: {name} Marketplace
home.subtitle: The platform that connects product providers with creative designers to build unique online stores.
home.badge: The new way to sell online
home.howItWorksDesc: Three simple steps to start selling unique customized products online.
home.step1Desc: Product manufacturers and suppliers list their products with customization options and variants.
home.step2Desc: Designers choose products, add their creative designs, set prices, and launch their own branded store.
home.step3Desc: Customers discover unique products in creator stores, customize them, and order with confidence.
home.feat1Desc: Get a custom subdomain with your brand name, colors, and logo. Fully yours.
home.feat2Desc: Apply your designs on any product — from t-shirts to jewelry. Mockups generated automatically.
home.feat3Desc: Earnings are split automatically between provider, creator, and platform via Stripe Connect.
home.feat4Desc: Sell globally with auto-translated stores supporting Arabic, English, Turkish, and German.
home.feat5Desc: Build beautiful product pages with drag & drop blocks — hero, gallery, FAQ, reviews, and more.
home.feat6Desc: Powered by Stripe with full PCI compliance. Customers pay securely, you get paid reliably.
home.ctaDesc: Join thousands of creators and providers building the future of e-commerce together.
home.providersDesc: Add your products and let creators market them worldwide
home.creatorsDesc: Add your creative designs and build your own store
home.customersDesc: Discover unique customized products from talented creators
